Body.Content:
What and Why:

We are introducing a new Copilot skill in PowerPoint that helps users create formal project kickoff presentations for kickoff meetings, project launches, and new-project alignment. The skill helps teams align on project goals, roles, milestones, scope, risks, schedule, success measures, and next steps.

Rollout Schedule:

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in mid October 2026 and expect to complete by late October 2026.

Impact on Your Organization:

Who is affected:

  • Users with access to Copilot in PowerPoint.

Platforms/Services:

  • Microsoft 365 apps (PowerPoint on Win32, Mac, and Web)

What will happen:

  • Users will be able to use a scenario-specific skill to create project kickoff presentation drafts.
  • This can help project teams prepare alignment materials faster and create a shared starting point for project execution.

Action Required/Recommendations:

No admin action is required. You may want to inform users that this new Copilot skill is becoming available in PowerPoint on Win32, Mac, and Web.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
